verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only end-user features of Microsoft Copilot: chat, Office app integrations, connectors, Browse with Copilot and Cowork. None of it describes a public API for driving the product programmatically, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404. A public API is a fair axis for an AI assistant product, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
